Optimize performance, cost, and security of containerized workloads on AWS. Advise clients on best practices for container adoption, migrating existing applications to containers (refactoring, replatforming), and modernizing applications. Implement advanced networking strategies for containers, including service mesh (e.g., AWS App Mesh, Istio). Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed container environments, from infrastructure to application layers. Stay up to date with the latest trends, AWS services, and tools in the container and Kubernetes ecosystem. Job Requirements Required Skills and Experience: Professional Experience: Experience in roles such as Cloud Architect, Platform Engineer, or Senior Consultant, with a strong focus on designing and implementing container solutions on AWS. Docker: Advanced experience in writing efficient Dockerfiles , building multi-layer images, and optimizing container images.
